items.text: Eagles OT Lane Johnson is inactive today (personal reasons). Rookie Markel Bell starts at RT; backup Fred Johnson also out. Eagles 18-29 without Johnson.
items.why: Personal reasons; listed Q then inactive.
items.implication: Further depletes Eagles OL already missing key pieces; negative for Hurts/pass protection and run game vs Rams.
items.opportunity: Rams pass rush/advantage; potential boost to LAR defense fantasy if applicable.

items.text: Commanders ruled out QB Marcus Mariota (knee) for today’s game vs. Colts; Athan Kaliakmanis in at QB (3rd-string debut).
items.why: Knee injury; downgraded with Omenihu also out.
items.implication: WAS offense fully depleted (Daniels already OUT, McLaurin inactive); major downgrade for all WAS skill players.

items.text: Eagles could now be without four of most important players: RT Lane Johnson (personal), WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), TE Dallas Goedert (knee), LB Zack Baun (concussion).
items.why: Smith/Goedert previously out; Johnson added inactive; Baun concussion.
items.implication: Major negative for Hurts efficiency/protection; target vacuum for remaining PHI pass-catchers; boost to LAR.
items.opportunity: Increased shares for remaining Eagles WRs/TEs/RBs if any; fade PHI skill somewhat.

items.text: ETR weekend summary: EXPECTED TO PLAY - Puka Nacua, Zay Flowers, Ladd McConkey, Tyjae Spears. GTD/OPTIMISTIC - Mike Evans. NOT EXPECTED - Jalen Coker, Terry McLaurin, Keenan Allen. STARTING - Tyson Bagent.
items.why: Compiled weekend reports aligning with Schefter/Rapoport.
items.implication: Core Sunday status guide for lineups; Bagent start with Williams out.
items.opportunity: Nacua/Flowers/McConkey volume; Evans GTD watch; fade McLaurin/Allen.

items.text: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin (hamstring) is officially inactive for today's London game vs. Colts.
items.why: Hamstring injury suffered late in the week in practice.
items.implication: WAS without top WR and already missing Jayden Daniels; targets shift to remaining pass-catchers amid 3rd-string QB situation.
items.opportunity: Increased target share for Diggs/Deebo and other WAS WRs/TEs.

items.text: Sources: Rams do not intend to limit Puka Nacua’s workload today vs. the Eagles.
items.why: Hip/groin; returning after missing Weeks 2-3; full workload expected.
items.implication: Full snap/route share expected; major upgrade for fantasy lineups.
items.opportunity: High-volume WR1 usage in favorable spot vs depleted Eagles secondary/OL.

items.text: Small dock only on Puka Nacua (groin) now; Rams do not intend to limit workload per Schefter. Full projection upgrade.
items.why: Schefter confirmation of no snap limit; returning healthy enough.
items.implication: Treat as near-full WR1; high confidence start.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets/red-zone in high-powered Rams offense vs short-handed Eagles.

items.text: Bigger dock on Ladd McConkey (foot, ribs); went LP-DNP-LP. Expected to play but caution on volume.
items.why: Foot injury after prior cracked rib; limited practice progression.
items.implication: Playable but lower projection/confidence; monitor pregame.
items.opportunity: Still primary LAC WR if active; routes may be managed.
items.conflict: Rapoport says likely to play, not as serious as rib.

items.text: Tinier dock on Zay Flowers (hamstring); not expected to have hard pitch count per beat.
items.why: Hamstring; positive reports on no hard limit.
items.implication: Near-full usage expected; solid WR start.

items.text: Bigger dock on Mike Evans (ribs); GTD/optimistic but managed projection.
items.why: Ribs; practiced late, team optimistic, Kittle notes fractured ribs suck.
items.implication: Monitor inactives/warmups closely; docked if plays.
items.opportunity: If active, still high-upside WR with Kittle.

items.text: Baker Mayfield dislocated thumb expected to sideline him 3-6 weeks depending on grip recovery.
items.why: Dislocated thumb; grip key to return.
items.implication: TB QB situation extended; impacts all Bucs pass-catchers ROS short-term.
items.opportunity: Backup QB stream/watch; elevated WR/TE if scheme adjusts.

items.text: Tyjae Spears (ankle) expected to play. Mike Evans (ribs) practiced late, will do best to play; team optimistic. Puka returns.
items.why: Positive practice/reports for Spears/Evans; Nacua confirmed return.
items.implication: Spears RB usage; Evans GTD monitor; Nacua full.
items.opportunity: Spears handcuff/lead if active; Evans upside.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey likely to play today after foot injury all week; not as serious as prior rib. Source.
items.why: Battled foot; recent rib but this less serious.
items.implication: Active expected; still start-worthy with dock.

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins (hamstring) return. DvP: Cowboys inflate opposing WR scoring 7.3% (most in NFL). Texans implied 7th-most points.
items.why: Return from hamstring into elite DvP matchup and high team total.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 play; prioritize in lineups.
items.opportunity: High target/route volume expected vs weak DAL secondary.

items.text: Moment Jordan Addison truthers waiting for: home vs borderline NFL secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
items.why: JJ ruled out (ankle); Addison primary option in favorable home matchup.
items.opportunity: WR1 target share, routes, red-zone for Addison.

items.text: Key OUTs include Justin Jefferson, Devonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, De'Von Achane, Breece Hall, Jayden Daniels, Caleb Williams, Baker Mayfield.
items.why: Various injuries; confirmed in Sunday dump.
items.implication: Handcuffs/backups elevated; Addison for JJ; remaining PHI for Smith/Goedert; MIA/NYJ RB adjustments; CHI Bagent; WAS Kaliakmanis.
items.opportunity: Clear roles for backups/handcuffs and secondary options.

items.text: Jaylen Warren LOVE: led RBs with 90% snap rate last week, 20 of 22 RB touches; strong volume profile.
items.why: Dominant snap/touch share in PIT backfield.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex start with clear lead role.
items.opportunity: High snap, carry, target share continues.

items.text: Justin Herbert HATE: pressured 44% dropbacks; SEA 4th in pressure, league-low 5.0 YPA allowed; Chargers bottom-3 implied total.
items.why: Tough matchup vs SEA pass rush/coverage; low team total.
